$comment: The render context for templates/btop/btop.conf.j2. One name: the selected theme FILE NAME (not a path) — btop matches color_theme only against the themes it discovered at startup, so an absolute path here is the silent-fallback bug the template documents.
title: btop/btop.conf.j2 — render context
description: The single value the btop config reads: the active theme's bare file name.

btop_config_active_theme.description: The theme file name btop selects, e.g. colors.btop.theme. A bare name: the pattern rejects `/`, because a path outside btop's scanned theme dirs resolves to nothing and falls back to the built-in default without an error.

x-render-contract.no_default_on_required: No `default(` fallback in the template. The consumer decides the fallback (its repo-owned active-theme setting, else the generated theme) BEFORE rendering; the template must not paper over a missing value.
x-render-contract.value_origin: The value is the consumer's mutable preference (design D10), never an asset: this repository ships the theme files and the selection contract, not the selection.
